expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current ping message with additional message types, clearer encoding and decoding rules, stronger validation and error reporting, and compatibility-focused tests so future clients can evolve the wire format reliably.

Shipped in v2: `Msg::Hello(String)` with an explicit `v:2` envelope.
